corinthians1.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

corinthians1.1.p1.b2.text: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, …

corinthians1.1.p1.b3.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

corinthians1.1.p2.b1.text: I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus.

corinthians1.1.p2.b2.text: For in Him you have been enriched in every way, in all speech and all knowledge,

corinthians1.1.p2.b3.text: God, who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful.

corinthians1.1.p3.b1.text: I appeal to you, brothers, … that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.

corinthians1.1.p3.b2.text: My brothers, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.

corinthians1.1.p4.b1.text: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into the name of Paul?

corinthians1.1.p4.b2.text: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,

corinthians1.1.p4.b3.text: Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that I do not remember if I baptized anyone else.

corinthians1.1.p4.b4.text: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, … lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.

corinthians1.1.p5.b1.text: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, …

corinthians1.1.p5.b2.text: … but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

corinthians1.1.p5.b3.text: For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.”

corinthians1.1.p6.b1.text: Where is the wise man? Where is the scribe? Where is the philosopher of this age?

corinthians1.1.p6.b2.text: Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

corinthians1.1.p6.b3.text: … God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.

corinthians1.1.p7.b1.text: Jews demand signs and Greeks search for wisdom,

corinthians1.1.p7.b2.text: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,

corinthians1.1.p7.b3.text: … Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

corinthians1.1.p8.b1.text: Brothers, consider the time of your calling: Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were powerful; not many were of noble birth.

corinthians1.1.p8.b2.text: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

corinthians1.1.p8.b3.text: so that no one may boast in His presence.

corinthians1.1.p9.b1.text: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.

corinthians1.1.p9.b2.text: Therefore, as it is written: “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
